Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 annual report, the Board of Commissioners' oversight report, and the audited consolidated financial statements. The meeting also granted a full discharge of liability to the Directors and Commissioners for their actions during the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: The meeting resolved not to distribute dividends or set aside reserve funds for the 2025 fiscal year because the company's retained earnings balance remains negative.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a registered public accountant to audit the 2026 financial statements. The Board will also determine the honorarium for the appointed firm.
Agenda #4: Shareholders delegated the authority to the Board of Commissioners to set the 2026 salaries, allowances, and facilities for all board members. This determination will follow recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Agenda #5: This agenda item served as a formal report to shareholders regarding the realization of the use of proceeds. No formal decision was required or made by the shareholders for this reporting item.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amendments to several articles of the Company's Articles of Association regarding meeting quorums and board structures. The Directors were authorized to formalize these changes via a Notarial Deed.
Agenda #7: The meeting accepted the resignations of three directors and appointed new members to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners. These appointments are for terms effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting.
